text:
The MGAP forest map 2021 (Uruguay's Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries) is the source that classifies the area as native forest. It places 13.1 ha of the event area in native forest, 0.4 ha outside mapped forest, and 0 ha in planted forest.

Two caveats:
- The MGAP map is a 2021 snapshot, and its role here is territorial context only, never the cause of the change.
- Hansen GFC maps the 13.5 ha of 2025 tree-cover loss but doesn't distinguish forest type. JRC GFC2020 only confirms forest at 2020 on 98% of the area, without separating native from planted.

The assessment is still pending corroboration, since no later year has been observed. The evidence doesn't establish deforestation, cause, legality, or who was responsible.
